name: MAGNIFICATION CONDUITS
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Apprentek or Cryptek performs a Shoot action, another friendly Hierotek Circle operative that is not a Plasmacyte, has an Engage order, is outside enemy control ranges and is visible to the shooter may serve as the Magnify viewpoint even though it is not an Apprentek or Cryptek.

name: PHASE SHIFTER
text: Once per turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Cryptek, at the start of the Roll Defence Dice step worsen the attacker's Piercing x by 1 for the rest of that sequence. Not usable for the Apprentek.

name: TESSERACT CUBE
text: In the Ready step, when you gain CP, if your Cryptek is in the killzone, outside enemy control ranges and was not reanimated this turning point, roll a D6: on a 1 the Cube is disabled for the battle, on 4+ gain 1 CP. After it has given 2 CP it is disabled for the battle.

name: TESLA WEAVE
text: Once per turning point, when an enemy operative ends a Charge action with one or more friendly Hierotek Circle operatives in its control range, it takes D3+1 damage.
